_doc: TRACK A -- THE RESONANT PARK TAP. Pre-registered acceptance, completeness band, chosen approach and the IDEAL-SOURCE INVENTORY. Written BEFORE the first deck of this round was generated; at the moment of writing this is the ONLY file in qal/park/ (mtime evidence printed in the report). Anchors below are READ FROM COMMITTED ARTIFACTS (qal/recov/skeptic/SKEPTIC_RESULTS.json and sk_best_long.cir.prn) and are USED, NOT RE-DERIVED.

handed_down_acceptance_DO_NOT_MOVE.rule: ADMITTED iff the COMPLETE ledger -- resonant gt/gtp + park tap + EVERY holder/clamp gate + the sustaining amplifier's replenishment loss + any DC bias -- is <= 12.7467 fJ/bank/hop WITH every completeness gate PASS.
handed_down_acceptance_DO_NOT_MOVE.N_min_formula: N_min = (39.6 + E)/0.8309, via the COMMITTED UNMODIFIED qal/zcd/restate_admission.py
handed_down_acceptance_DO_NOT_MOVE.headroom_derivation: 12.7467 - 2.974 (the surviving resonant gt/gtp pair). The '~1.5 fJ -> E 4.474 -> N_min 53.04' figure in the record is the COMFORTABLE case, NOT the bar.
handed_down_acceptance_DO_NOT_MOVE.NEVER_quote_recovery_percentage: eta is LOAD-referenced; the admission line is DRIVER-referenced; the campaign's as-built ratio is 7.0x. Quote fJ/bank/hop only.

anchors_used_not_rederived.provenance: qal/recov/skeptic/sk_best_long.cir.prn (committed), row m1d_h5b580_adv6, tend 1000 ps, free-running 5-harmonic taps, beat 580 ps, RS 25 ohm, gtp phase-advanced 6 ps

IDEAL_SOURCE_INVENTORY._doc: EVERY term in the complete ledger still supplied by an ideal source or an assumed efficiency. The campaign's lesson: each such term has, three times, turned out to be the thing that killed the result. Enumerated BEFORE measuring anything.

IS1_park_driver.booked: 2.403 fJ = Q_pk*VGH from an ideal PWL step (recov round); 2.660 fJ by the deck's own 1F integrator
IS1_park_driver.measured_real_floor: 15.0-15.5 fJ (one minimum sg13g2_inv_1, zero junction cap, free ideal input, no delay chain)

IS2_sustaining_amplifier.booked: eta_amp >= 35.1% (zero DC bias) to 44.6% (with 2.71 fJ worst-case tap DC bias)

IS3_the_NETTING_of_the_gt_and_gtp_taps.status: NEW THIS ROUND -- IDEAL-SOURCE BOOKING #3, and the largest unexamined term in the headline itself
IS3_the_NETTING_of_the_gt_and_gtp_taps.what_is_booked: The 2.974 fJ headline is the ARITHMETIC SUM of a net EXPORTER (E_gt = -2.749 fJ, Miller-harvested from the swinging sw/bkb nodes) and a net IMPORTER (E_gtp = +5.723 fJ). In the deck these are TWO ELECTRICALLY UNCONNECTED ideal voltage sources -- the skeptic's own audit states 'no gt-gtp conductive path exists in the netlist'. Summing them books a LOSSLESS, BIDIRECTIONAL common tank that returns 100% of the gt tap's harvest to the gtp tap, and that tank has never been built or measured.
IS3_the_NETTING_of_the_gt_and_gtp_taps.sensitivity: E_pair(eta_net) = 5.7232 - 2.7489*eta_net. eta_net=1.0 -> 2.974 fJ (the booked headline). eta_net=0.5 -> 4.349 fJ. eta_net=0 -> 5.723 fJ.
IS3_the_NETTING_of_the_gt_and_gtp_taps.why_it_matters: the swing is 2.749 fJ = 28.1% of the entire 9.7727 fJ park headroom, and it sits INSIDE the number everybody is treating as measured-and-closed
IS3_the_NETTING_of_the_gt_and_gtp_taps.note: this is distinct from IS2. IS2 is the loss of replenishing the tank; IS3 is whether the harvest reaches the tank at all.
IS3_the_NETTING_of_the_gt_and_gtp_taps.owner: flagged by track A; not resolvable by track A's decks (it needs the tank/combiner built)

IS4_tap_DC_bias_supply_AND_its_reference.status: BOUNDED, NOT MEASURED; and the bias LEVELS themselves are booked at zero
IS4_tap_DC_bias_supply_AND_its_reference.measured: Q_net per cycle: gt +0.702 fC, gtp +1.276 fC (my extraction of the committed prn) -- a free-running LC cannot source net DC charge
IS4_tap_DC_bias_supply_AND_its_reference.bound: up to 1.978 fC * 1.5 V = 2.97 fJ if referenced to the 1.5 V rail
IS4_tap_DC_bias_supply_AND_its_reference.second_half_never_stated: the two taps sit on DC offsets of 0.85 V (gt) and 0.41 V (gtp). NEITHER IS A RAIL. Generating and holding two non-rail references costs area and quiescent power that no deck in this campaign has ever metered.

IS5_harmonic_synthesis_and_phase_network.what: each tap is ONE ideal PWL source already containing sum_{k odd<=5} sin(k*theta)/k at exact 1 : 1/3 : 1/5 amplitude ratio and exact relative phase, and the gtp tap carries an independent 6 ps phase ADVANCE. A real network needs a combiner (or a 3-mode resonator with fixed tap ratios) plus a phase path, and all of its loss is currently folded into a single lumped 25 ohm series R that was swept, not built.

IS6_inductor_Q.what: Q >= 7 required by energy, 3.8-6.7 by cut order; L1 = 5.9 nH at B=64 with shared series R <= 8.4 ohm. The inductor is IDEAL in every deck; no metal inductor Q is measured anywhere in the campaign.

IS7_VHI_pMOS_bulk_rail.status: MEASURED BUT UNBOOKED IN EVERY LEDGER
IS7_VHI_pMOS_bulk_rail.what: the 1.5 V n-well rail of the transfer pMOS draws 4.494 fJ/hop in the committed best row. It has no home in either the hop ledger or the timer ledger. 4.49 fJ is 35% of the whole 12.7467 fJ budget. Pre-existing campaign omission, re-flagged. This round will re-measure it over a FULL BEAT (the committed figure is read at tend of a single-hop deck) to say whether it is a net cost or a transient that returns.

IS8_fixed_phase_cannot_retune_per_data_w.status: MEASURED RISK, not an ideal source
IS8_fixed_phase_cannot_retune_per_data_w.what: skeptic: a +-2-cell data change moves the pMOS-vs-nMOS ordering margin over 4.9 ps of the 5 ps allowance; the tuned gtp advance is one fixed phase

chosen_approach_and_why.first: (d) MERGE / ELIMINATE -- drive the park nMOS gate DIRECTLY from the existing gtp tap. Reason, from reading the committed waveform before building anything: the pMOS transfer gate signal ALREADY has exactly the park's required shape and polarity -- LOW through the transfer (pMOS on), HIGH through the hold (pMOS off). gps runs -0.34 V (hard park off) to +1.16 V (park on) and is above 0.45 V from ~431 ps to ~137 ps of the next beat. The cheapest possible park is no park tap at all: no new mode, no new inductor, no new bias, and -- decisively for the recursion trap -- NO NEW GATE, so there is nothing left to drive.
chosen_approach_and_why.why_the_ordering_should_work_for_free: break-before-make falls out of THRESHOLD ORDERING, not tuning. On the rising gtp edge the pMOS cuts at gtp > V(bkb)-|Vtp| ~ 0.18 V and the park closes at gtp > Vtn ~ 0.45 V, so the pMOS ALWAYS cuts first. On the falling edge the park opens at 0.45 V and the pMOS conducts at 0.18 V, so the park ALWAYS releases first. Both directions are guaranteed by the sign of (Vtn) - (Vbkb - |Vtp|) > 0.
chosen_approach_and_why.then_if_it_fails: (c) SUB-HARMONIC / separate-offset tap on the SAME modes (a third tap, own DC offset, own amplitude -- costs IS4 bias but still no switch), then (a) more harmonics for a flatter top, then (b) resonant pulse + clamp LAST because the clamp is the M1-C/M2 recursion.
chosen_approach_and_why.recursion_rule: ANY device this track adds is charged in the same ledger: its own gate drive at the CONVENTIONAL rate (Q_rect/2 * V per full cycle) unless that gate is itself measured on a tap. A holder whose width must track its load is declared a B-INVARIANT recursion and the row is reported as FAILING regardless of its energy.

cost_accounting_rule_for_the_merged_park.primary: park cost = E_gtp(park merged onto the gtp tap) - E_gtp(baseline, park on the committed ideal PWL), both from the SAME 1F instrument on the SAME deck family at the SAME tend. This captures, exactly and completely, the extra I^2R in the tap resistance AND the extra nonlinear MOS gate dissipation AND any extra net DC charge the park gate draws.
cost_accounting_rule_for_the_merged_park.cross_check_independent: a 0 V series source VPKM between gtp and the park gate, with its own 1F energy and rectified-charge integrators, gives the energy delivered INTO the park gate node by a path that is not the primary instrument. Additionally the trapezoid reconstruction I_tap = (V(gps)-V(gtp))/RS, which never touches any 1F integrator, is reported for the headline row.
cost_accounting_rule_for_the_merged_park.DC_bias_delta: Delta Q_net on the gtp tap is reported and charged at the IS4 bound (1.5 V reference).
cost_accounting_rule_for_the_merged_park.no_credit_for_the_gt_tap_export_unless_s: rows are reported BOTH as the booked net (eta_net = 1, the campaign's convention) AND with the IS3 sensitivity band.

completeness_gates_UNCHANGED_a_row_that_.checkpoint: tD = 811.755 ps ABSOLUTE, regardless of deck tend; tC = t_open + 7 ps
completeness_gates_UNCHANGED_a_row_that_.E_hop_open: within +-5% of the real-drive reference 8.10914 fJ -> [7.70368, 8.51460]
completeness_gates_UNCHANGED_a_row_that_.cut_order: pMOS (gtp) cuts EARLY-or-with the nMOS (allowance +5 ps late); nMOS (gt) cuts at the tuned zero; PARK closes STRICTLY AFTER the nMOS cut (park_minus_nmos > 0). Reported on BOTH the 50% convention and the device-referenced (last-conducting-instant) convention.
completeness_gates_UNCHANGED_a_row_that_.ledger_closure: every drive ledger must close to <= 1%: E_source - E_Rseries - E_into_gate_node = 0

NEW_PRE_REGISTERED_HOLD_GATES_for_this_t.H1_the_park_actually_holds: V(sw) <= 0.10 V at EVERY printed sample from park-close to tD. A park that lets sw float back up has not parked.
NEW_PRE_REGISTERED_HOLD_GATES_for_this_t.H2_the_delivered_rail_does_not_sag: the droop V(bkb)(tD) - V(bkb)(tC) must be no more negative than the committed ideal-park baseline's same difference by more than 1.0 mV. A park that sags is a COMPLETENESS FAILURE even if the energy looks good.
NEW_PRE_REGISTERED_HOLD_GATES_for_this_t.H3_the_hold_survives_a_PERIODIC_drive: with the harmonic taps repeated for >= 2 beats (not flat-lined after one, which is the committed single-hop deck convention and holds the park on forever by artifact), the park must stay closed for the WHOLE remaining beat, i.e. until the next beat's pMOS turn-on, and V(bkb) must not sag more than 1% over that window. The beat-limited hold is the architecture (each beat is a hop); what is forbidden is releasing EARLY.
NEW_PRE_REGISTERED_HOLD_GATES_for_this_t.H4_no_new_gate: if the scheme needs any added device, its gate drive is counted (see recursion_rule) and the row is reported with that cost inside the headline, never beside it.

falsifiable_predictions_PRE_STATED.PA_P1_merge_ordering_is_free: Tying the park gate to gtp satisfies the cut order with NO retuning, because park-close (gtp > Vtn = 0.45) necessarily follows pMOS-cut (gtp > Vbkb - |Vtp| ~ 0.18) on the same rising edge, and precedes pMOS-on on the falling edge. PREDICTION: park_minus_nmos > 0 and pmos_minus_nmos <= +5 ps at the committed adv = 6 ps. FALSIFIED if park closes before the nMOS cut, or if the pMOS/park overlap drains the rail (VA_open > 0.1478).
falsifiable_predictions_PRE_STATED.PA_P2_merge_cost_is_small: The incremental cost is the added nonlinear gate dissipation of a 1 um nMOS placed on an ALREADY-EXISTING tap. The campaign measured 1.66 fJ as the harmonic surcharge for the 5 um + 10 um transfer pair (15 um of gate), so a 1 um addition should scale to roughly 0.1-0.4 fJ. PREDICTION: Delta E_gtp <= 1.0 fJ. FALSIFIED if Delta E_gtp > 1.0 fJ.
falsifiable_predictions_PRE_STATED.PA_P3_the_weaker_high_level_still_parks: The merged park's HIGH level is the gtp peak, 1.16 V, not 1.5 V, so Vgs is ~0.34 V lower and Ron is materially higher. PREDICTION: a 1 um park still holds V(sw) <= 0.10 V because it only has to sink the post-open ring current. FALSIFIED if H1 fails at w = 1 um; the remedy (a wider park, which adds gate cap to the tap) is then measured as a sweep and its cost booked.
falsifiable_predictions_PRE_STATED.PA_P4_zero_recursion: The merge adds NO new gate anywhere, so the M1-C / M2 recursion (a holder that itself needs a driver, whose width tracks its load, and which therefore never amortises over B) is structurally absent -- not small, absent. FALSIFIED if any added device turns out to be necessary.
falsifiable_predictions_PRE_STATED.PA_P5_the_single_hop_deck_convention_fla: The committed deck's PWL ends at one beat and Xyce holds the last value, so BOTH the committed ideal park (1.5 V forever) and a merged park (1.1014 V forever) are held on by artifact past 580 ps. PREDICTION: under a genuinely PERIODIC drive the merged park releases at the next beat's falling gtp edge (~717 ps) and the pre-registered tD = 811.755 ps lies OUTSIDE the hold window. This is a property of the CHECKPOINT, not of the park, and will be reported as such: gates at tD under the committed single-hop convention, plus the true beat-limited hold window measured separately.

sim_discipline.base_deck: /usr/local/src/stat-sim/qal/recov/skeptic/sk_best.cir, itself a committed text patch of qal/swsweep/sw_tg15p_z.cir; every deck in this round is a TEXT PATCH of it and the patch script PRINTS every removed and added line
sim_discipline.models: sg13_lv via qal/sg13lv_compat.sp (NOTE: it drops ad/as/pd/ps, so junction capacitance is ZERO and every driver number is a LOWER BOUND); PSP103 via .hdl + sg13g2_psp103_tt.lib
sim_discipline.metering: 1F-integrator or INTEG-I(Vsrc)+PARAM forms ONLY. '.measure INTEGRAL V(<B-source>)' under-reports 11-44% and is not used. Every rail/tank that sources or sinks charge gets its own integrator and the ledger must CLOSE.
sim_discipline.cross_check: the headline row is independently reconstructed by trapezoid integration of I = (V(gps)-V(gtp))/RS from the printed node voltages -- a path that never touches the 1F instrument
sim_discipline.reserved: vt / gmin not touched; unique .va module names; runs < 4 min; corners ONLY via instance-level DTA
sim_discipline.tend: 1000 ps for every gate-evaluated row (so tD = 811.755 ps is reached and rows are digit-comparable to the committed sk_best_long); 1160 ps (2 beats) for the periodic hold test

verdict_rules.ADMITTED: complete ledger <= 12.7467 fJ/bank/hop AND every completeness gate PASS AND every hold gate PASS, with the residual ideal-source terms named and their sensitivity bands stated
verdict_rules.CONDITIONAL: ledger clears the line but a named term is still ideal/assumed -- report the band, never a point claim
verdict_rules.EXCLUDED: report the best COMPLETE ledger and WHERE THE MONEY WENT. A negative result closes the question and is first-class.
verdict_rules.honesty: every number labelled MEASURED / DERIVED / ASSUMED
